receipt.public_excerpt: About 46.9% of organizations report actual AI spend exceeding their planned AI budget, according to new research from The Futurum Group, compared with just 5.6% that came in below plan.

evidence_items.explanation: By the second half of 2026, AI spend was running over plan at nearly half of enterprises. That points away from broad tightening so far, but it does not settle an open-ended forecast.

receipt.public_excerpt: Among the 767 organizations running over plan, 47.6% ask for more budget and 43.3% absorb the overrun and settle it later, while only 17.2% pause or reduce the AI initiative itself.

evidence_items.explanation: A minority of over-budget firms are cutting back, which partly fits Marcus's view. Most are funding the overrun instead.

unresolved_gaps: No deadline, so later tightening could still happen.
